body:
## EXPAND
Leads checked beyond the core synthesis: dedicated event-store products are overkill for this MVP; faster-whisper's own repository does not establish production Korean streaming SLOs; Deepgram endpointing recommendations are conversational defaults, not Korean presentation benchmarks; Azure security trimming is filtering rather than authentication; external fetch introduces SSRF and prompt-injection boundaries; Korean coaching should use per-speaker sustained deviations rather than a universal rate threshold. No additional high-value architecture lane remains without empirical bake-offs (Korean STT corpus, search-source latency/recall, verifier false-support rate, and presenter approval usability).
